name: OpenPencil (design files)
what: An open Figma-compatible design editor. LOKI's design tool and Forge > Design drive its command line headlessly: import HTML/CSS as layers, draw JSX, the Figma Plugin API, export PNG / SVG / JSX / Tailwind / HTML / PPTX, lint for contrast and spacing.

export.what: Export a design (.fig) as png, svg, jsx, tailwind-jsx, html or pptx.

lint.what: Check a design for contrast, spacing and naming problems.

notes: Node.js 20+. PDF export is broken in 0.16.0 (export svg instead). The MCP server (openpencil-mcp) only works while the OpenPencil desktop app is open (brew install --cask openpencil / winget install --id OpenPencil.OpenPencil --exact); the CLI needs no app. Telemetry is switched off for every run (OPENPENCIL_TELEMETRY=0).

name: mobile-mcp (phone and emulator testing)
what: Lets LOKI's agents test apps on iOS simulators, Android emulators and real phones: list devices, install and launch the app, read the screen's elements, tap, type, swipe, take screenshots of the phone, read its logs.

serve.what: Run the MCP server over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 (agents connect to /mcp).

notes: Mac: Xcode with a booted simulator (xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 16"); move Xcode's DerivedData to the external drive. PC: Android platform-tools (adb on PATH, ANDROID_HOME) and an emulator or a phone with USB debugging. Telemetry off: MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1. LOKI's own phone app is dev.m03.loki (loki:// links need MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1).
